$comment: Declarative workspace skeleton from docs/corpus/31_REBUILD_PLAN.md. tools/workspaces.mjs materialises it; tools/boundaries.mjs derives the dependency graph from owner_features via docs/governance/v2-ids.json, so internal dependency edges are never hand-maintained.
$additional_internal_dependencies: Escape hatch for an edge the feature graph cannot express: two packages owned by the SAME feature, where one imports the other. Feature dependencies cannot be self-referential, so `packages/authoring` depending on `packages/core` (both owned by FEAT-004) is invisible to the derivation. Found by the build pipeline, not by the boundary gate — the gate checked declarations, and the declaration was missing.
